user.title: Add TTS Agent (Step 1 of 2)
user.description: Pick a name and the OpenAI model. Voice and audio options come next.

voice_audio.title: Add TTS Agent (Step 2 of 2)
voice_audio.description: Voice and audio options for model {model}. Note: enabling chime disables streaming, because the chime has to be attached to the finished audio.

data.extra_payload: Extra JSON payload (for custom TTS backends)

data_description.stream_pipelining: Starts speaking as soon as the first sentence is ready, instead of waiting for the whole reply to be written. Only affects the voice assistant, and needs MP3 or PCM.
data_description.audio_format: MP3 is the safe default. Change it only if your backend requires another format.
data_description.send_voice: On by default. Turn it off for a backend that rejects the voice field, such as audio.cpp serving Chatterbox or VoxCPM2.

reconfigure.description: Pick the model. Voice and audio options come next.

reconfigure_voice.title: Update TTS Agent (Step 2 of 2)
reconfigure_voice.description: Voice and audio options for model {model}. Note: enabling chime disables streaming, because the chime has to be attached to the finished audio.

data.extra_payload: Extra JSON payload (for custom TTS backends)

data_description.stream_pipelining: Starts speaking as soon as the first sentence is ready, instead of waiting for the whole reply to be written. Only affects the voice assistant, and needs MP3 or PCM.
data_description.audio_format: MP3 is the safe default. Change it only if your backend requires another format.
data_description.send_voice: On by default. Turn it off for a backend that rejects the voice field, such as audio.cpp serving Chatterbox or VoxCPM2.

error.already_exists: A profile with this name already exists
error.pipelining_needs_no_chime: Turn the chime off to stream. A chime has to be attached to the finished audio, so speech cannot start before the reply is complete.
error.pipelining_needs_joinable_format: Pick MP3 or PCM to stream. The other formats either cannot be joined end to end, or state a total length in their header that is not known until the audio ends.

init.title: Configure TTS options
init.description: Configure settings for this TTS profile

data.chime: Enable chime sound prior speech (useful for announcements)
data.normalize_audio: Enable loudness for generated audio (uses more CPU)
data.volume_restore: Restore speaker volumes after TTS playback
data.announce_mode: Announcement mode (speakers duck or pause instead of replacing what is playing)
data.pause_playback: Always pause current media before speaking

voice_deleted.title: TTS voice was deleted upstream
voice_deleted.description: The voice `{voice}` used by TTS agent `{profile}` no longer exists on the provider. Open the agent's Reconfigure dialog and pick a current voice.

say.name: OpenAI TTS Speak
say.description: Uses the OpenAI TTS engine to speak a message, with optional chime, normalisation and volume control.

tts_entity.name: TTS entity
tts_entity.description: The TTS entity to speak with.

voice.name: Voice
voice.description: Voice to use instead of the one the profile is configured with. Voices marked as gpt-4o-mini-tts only are rejected by tts-1 and tts-1-hd. Any name can be typed for a custom backend.

speed.name: Speed
speed.description: Speed of the speech, from 0.25 to 4.0, where 1.0 is normal.

instructions.name: Instructions
instructions.description: Speaking style for the gpt-4o-mini-tts model, for example "speak like a pirate". Custom backends may ignore it.

extra_payload.name: Extra payload
extra_payload.description: Additional JSON merged into the API request, for custom backends that take extra parameters.

chime.name: Play chime
chime.description: Plays a chime before the message. Falls back to the profile setting when omitted. Turns streaming off, because the chime has to be joined to the audio first.

chime_sound.name: Chime sound
chime_sound.description: Filename of the chime to play. Turns streaming off, as above.

normalize_audio.name: Normalise audio
normalize_audio.description: Applies loudness normalisation, which is on by default. Falls back to the profile setting when omitted. Works with streaming.

volume.name: Volume
volume.description: Volume for this announcement only, 0.0 to 1.0, restored afterwards. Setting it pauses the music instead of ducking it.

announce.name: Announcement mode
announce.description: On by default: speakers that support announcements duck the music, the rest are paused and resumed. Off sends the audio as ordinary media.

set_api_key.name: Set API key
set_api_key.description: Stores a new API key on an OpenAI TTS entry and reloads it. Meant for providers that issue short-lived keys, so an automation can refresh the key without anyone opening the settings. The key is written to Home Assistant's own storage, not to an entity, but note that automation traces keep the data a service was called with.

config_entry_id.name: Entry
config_entry_id.description: The OpenAI TTS entry that holds the key.

tts_entity.name: TTS entity
tts_entity.description: Any TTS entity of the entry, if you would rather name one of those than the entry itself.

validate.name: Check the key first
validate.description: Try the key against the endpoint before storing it, so a bad one is refused instead of breaking the next announcement. Costs one very short request.
